en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Amro Bin Usman, from Ali Bin Isa, raising it,

‘He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘Among what Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Whispered to Musa<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup> with, was: “O Musa<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>! Do not have lengthy expectancies in the world for it would harden your heart, and the one of a cruel heart is remote from Me<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>”’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Amr ibn ‘Uthman from Ali ibn ‘Isa in a marfu’ manner has said

the following: “It is in the conversations of Moses with Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, ‘O Moses, do not prolong your hopes in the world; it hardens your heart and the hardhearted people are far away from Me.’”
